arguments.command:
set -e
TAG=cassette_settings_region3
export DRIVE_TARGET=linux
export DRIVE_SESSION_TAG="$TAG"
export DRIVE_RUN_LOG="/tmp/flutter_run_${TAG}.log"
export DRIVE_FLUTTER_FIFO="/tmp/flutter_input_${TAG}"
export DRIVE_DESKTOP_HOME="/tmp/nothingness_${TAG}"
mkdir -p "$DRIVE_DESKTOP_HOME/.config" "$DRIVE_DESKTOP_HOME/.local/share"
if [ ! -p "$DRIVE_FLUTTER_FIFO" ]; then rm -f "$DRIVE_FLUTTER_FIFO" "$DRIVE_RUN_LOG"; mkfifo "$DRIVE_FLUTTER_FIFO"; fi
nohup sh -c 'sleep infinity' > "$DRIVE_FLUTTER_FIFO" 2>/dev/null & FIFO_WRITER_PID=$!
nohup flutter run -d linux --debug -t dev/main_debug.dart < "$DRIVE_FLUTTER_FIFO" > "$DRIVE_RUN_LOG" 2>&1 & FLUTTER_PID=$!
# wait for agent
for i in $(seq 1 240); do
  if env DRIVE_TARGET=linux DRIVE_SESSION_TAG="$TAG" DRIVE_RUN_LOG="$DRIVE_RUN_LOG" DRIVE_FLUTTER_FIFO="$DRIVE_FLUTTER_FIFO" \
     /workspace/.agents/skills/agent-emulator-debugging/scripts/drive.py contract >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    break
  fi
  sleep 1
  if [ $i -eq 240 ]; then
    echo "Timed out waiting for contract" >&2
    tail -n 200 "$DRIVE_RUN_LOG" >&2 || true
    exit 1
  fi
done

D=/workspace/.agents/skills/agent-emulator-debugging/scripts/drive.py
env DRIVE_TARGET=linux DRIVE_SESSION_TAG="$TAG" DRIVE_RUN_LOG="$DRIVE_RUN_LOG" DRIVE_FLUTTER_FIFO="$DRIVE_FLUTTER_FIFO" $D screen cassette
env DRIVE_TARGET=linux DRIVE_SESSION_TAG="$TAG" DRIVE_RUN_LOG="$DRIVE_RUN_LOG" DRIVE_FLUTTER_FIFO="$DRIVE_FLUTTER_FIFO" $D settings open
env DRIVE_TARGET=linux DRIVE_SESSION_TAG="$TAG" DRIVE_RUN_LOG="$DRIVE_RUN_LOG" DRIVE_FLUTTER_FIFO="$DRIVE_FLUTTER_FIFO" $D shoot cassette_settings_after_change

SHOT=$(ls -1 .tmp/agent_shots/cassette_settings_after_change*.png | tail -n 1)
echo "SHOT: $SHOT"

kill "$FLUTTER_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
kill "$FIFO_WRITER_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
